title: Knowledge Base
markdown:
**What it is:** Your company's documents, in one place. Add handbooks, past decks, policies and plans, and the Executive reads them when answering. Files from a connected Google Drive folder or Notion workspace show up here too.

**What it does:**

- Opens on **Company documents**: one list of everything the Executive reads about your company, newest first.
- Marks each document with where it came from — **Uploaded**, **Google Drive** or **Notion** — and when it was added or last synced.
- Indexes each document automatically so specialists can pull the relevant passages into their reasoning.
- Keeps connected sources up to date on a schedule, with a **Sync now** button when you can't wait.
- Under the **Advanced** tab: approve knowledge in the **Review queue**, add your own playbooks and lessons learned under **Built-in playbooks**, browse the **Reference library**, and test retrieval in **Query test**.

**How to use:**

*Add a document*

1. Open **Knowledge** in the sidebar. It opens on the **Company documents** tab.
2. Drag files onto the drop area, or click **Add documents** (PDF, Word, Markdown or text, up to 50 MB each). You can add several at once.
3. Once *Adding…* finishes, the document is searchable. Click its name or **View** to read the text the Executive sees; **Delete**, in the row's **⋯** menu, removes it. To replace a document, delete it and add the new version.

*Documents from Google Drive or Notion*

1. An administrator connects them with environment settings (see `docs/drive_sync_setup.md` and the other sync setup guides in `docs/`). Their files then appear in the list with a **Google Drive** or **Notion** badge, the time they were last synced and when they were last edited.
2. **Open in Google Drive ↗** (or Notion), in the row's **⋯** menu, opens the original. Synced files can't be deleted here — remove them from the shared folder or Notion and they drop off on the next sync.
3. Each connected source has a card above the list showing when it last synced and how often it syncs. Click **Sync now** to pick up a change straight away. If a sync failed, the card says why and links to the settings.

*Check what the Executive will find*

1. Open the **Advanced** tab, then **Query test**, type a question, and click **Run**.
2. Optionally narrow by **Specialist**, by source (**Include**), or by **Domains**. The results show which passages would be pulled and which specialists would see them — a lower distance means a closer match.

*Add your own playbook*

1. Open the **Advanced** tab, then **Built-in playbooks**, and click **+ Playbook** (or **+ Failure case** for a lessons-learned case). Pick the domain it belongs to.
2. Enter a filename and the Markdown content, then click **Create file**.
3. New playbooks wait in the **Review queue** and aren't used until you approve them — or click **Approve** under the filename. Open any playbook and use **Edit** / **Preview** to change it later; **Flag for revision** and **Delete file** are in its **⋯** menu.

**Example:** add `pricing-policy-2026.pdf`, then in **Query test** ask *"what discount can sales offer without approval?"* to confirm the right passage comes back.

*Note: there's also a read-only built-in knowledge base (curated business know-how) that ships with the app. Files attached in chat are not added to Knowledge.*
